title: Migrate callback code to async/await
description: `src/profile.js` loads a user profile with deeply nested Node-style callbacks. Refactor `loadProfile` to `async function loadProfile(db, id)` that returns a Promise resolving to the same result shape and rejecting with the same errors. The `db` object stays callback-based (its methods take a Node-style callback), so you must wrap it yourself. Comment counts for the posts must be fetched concurrently, not one after another. `test/profile.test.js` describes the required behaviour.
